name: Launch Side Project Full Time
description: End-to-end workflow for turning a side project into a full-time business. Covers idea validation before you invest heavily, building a minimum viable product, generating initial revenue, making the strategic transition from employment to self-employment, and scaling the business for sustainable growth. Use when the user wants to launch side project full time or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
